question: Where was the Combined Operational Review and Evaluation (CORE) Programme organised by the Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS) from 22 to 26 September 2025?

options.text: Defence Services Staff College, Wellington, Tamil Nadu
United Service Institution of India, New Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Service Institution of India, New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Combined Operational Review and Evaluation (CORE)** Programme is a high-level tri-service engagement aimed at enhancing the strategic and operational synergy among the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• The programme was organised by the **Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS)** from **22 to 26 September 2025**.
 
• The venue for this prestigious event was the **United Service Institution of India (USI)**, located in **New Delhi**. This institution serves as a premier center for research into national security and defense matters.
 
• The primary objective of the **CORE Programme** is to provide a platform for senior military leadership to evaluate current operational doctrines and evolve a unified approach toward **future warfare** scenarios.
 
• It focuses on fostering **Jointness** and **Integration** across the **Indian Army**, **Indian Navy**, and **Indian Air Force** to ensure a cohesive response to national security threats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **United Service Institution of India (USI):**
 
 
• Established in **1870** by **Major General Sir Charles MacGregor**, the **USI** is one of India's oldest national security and defense think tanks.
 
• Located in **New Delhi**, it provides a venue for lectures, discussions, and research on military history, strategy, and international relations.
 
• It plays a critical role in professional military education and the development of strategic culture in India.
 
 
 
• **Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS):**
 
 
• **HQ IDS** was created on **October 1, 2001**, based on the recommendations of the **Kargil Review Committee**.
 
• It operates under the **Ministry of Defence** and is headed by the **Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to the Chairman, Chiefs of Staff Committee (CISC)**.
 
• Its primary mission is to promote "Jointness" for "Victory" by coordinating between the different branches of the military in planning, procurement, and training.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Significance of CORE:**
 
 
• The programme addresses modern challenges such as **Cyber Warfare**, **Space Defence**, and **Electronic Warfare (EW)**.
 
• It facilitates discussions on the transition toward **Integrated Theatre Commands**, which is a major reform intended to streamline command structures.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Jointness and Integration:** The **CORE** programme is a step toward the goal of a fully integrated military force under the guidance of the **Chief of Defence Staff (CDS)**.
 
• **Future Warfare Training:** The curriculum of such programmes often includes **artificial intelligence (AI)** in combat, **drone technology**, and **asymmetric warfare** tactics.
 
• **Location Context:** While institutions like the **National Defence Academy (NDA)** in **Pune** and the **Indian Military Academy (IMA)** in **Dehradun** focus on initial officer training, the **USI** in **New Delhi** focuses on high-level strategic review and policy-level evaluation.
 
• **Role of CDS:** The creation of the post of **Chief of Defence Staff** in **December 2019** has significantly boosted the effectiveness of the **HQ IDS** in conducting such tri-service evaluations.
</ul
